trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    if not pts:return out
    color=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if color in grid[r]]
    lo=min(rows); hi=max(rows)
    bh=hi-lo+1
    diffs=[]
    for r in rows:
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        diffs += [b-a for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]) if b-a>1]
    period=Counter(diffs).most_common(1)[0][0] if diffs else 4
    for r in range(lo):
        steps=(lo-r+bh-1)//bh
        src=r+steps*bh
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if grid[src][c]==color]
        if not cs:continue
        dense=len(cs)>1 and all(b-a==1 for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]))
        for c in range(w):
            if dense or (c+3*steps-cs[0])%period==0:out[r][c]=color
    return out
